scenes.title: Codecks
scenes.subtitle: Turn the Android phone already on your desk into Mac controls.
scenes.narration: Meet Codecks. Turn the Android phone already on your desk into a command deck, trackpad, keyboard, clipboard bridge, and automation surface for your Mac.

scenes.title: Trackpad that fails closed
scenes.narration: Bluetooth trackpad input stays unavailable until you explicitly pair and choose a Mac.

scenes.title: Type, then choose the Enter
scenes.narration: Compose text on the phone, reuse snippets, and send with Enter or Command Enter.

scenes.title: Clipboard without messaging yourself
scenes.narration: Move text manually in either direction, or choose visible one-way or two-way sync.

scenes.title: Automation stays reviewable
scenes.narration: Build local When, If, Then rules. Changed rules must be tested again before they run.

scenes.title: Make the Deck yours
scenes.narration: Reorder, resize, replace, test, and style the controls that deserve permanent space.

scenes.title: Search everything else
scenes.narration: The Command Palette keeps occasional actions searchable without crowding your Deck.

scenes.title: Restricted while locked
scenes.narration: Optional lockscreen access permits pointer controls only after Bluetooth is already connected. It never reconnects, types, runs commands, or exposes settings.

scenes.title: Open source. Local-first.
scenes.subtitle: github.com/vaddisrinivas/codecks
scenes.narration: Open source, local-first, and ready to try from GitHub.
